## Description

/settings/audit: filter by staff member, patient (search), action, date range; shows time, actor, role, action, patient (name visible to the owner after selecting), purpose and outcome (allowed/denied). Export to CSV (watermarked, audited).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Only practice owners/admins can open the log (403 for others, audited).
- [ ] **AC2.** Filtering by patient lists every read and write of that patient's record by anyone, with timestamps.
- [ ] **AC3.** Denied attempts (e.g. receptionist opening a clinical note) appear with outcome "Denied".
- [ ] **AC4.** Exports are audited and watermarked with exporter and time.
- [ ] **AC5.** Query p95 < 600 ms for a 30-day range in the pilot volume.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
